issues.issue: The party definition sweeps in unnamed "subsidiaries" of Boston Scientific collectively as "BSC", without identifying them or fixing a date at which subsidiary status is measured. A court could be asked whether disclosures to, or by, a particular affiliate are covered and who may enforce the confidentiality duties.

The "Project" is defined by a specific item, "Orbus' coronary R. stent platform", followed by the open catch-all "and other stent products", so the outer boundary of the Project is indeterminate. Because the permitted-use clause confines use of Proprietary Information to the Project, the scope of that catch-all decides what use is licensed.

"Information" is defined open-endedly ("in any form, including but not limited to") and extends to mere "physical observation", giving the term no ascertainable boundary. That breadth has to be reconciled with the marking regime, since observed information may never be capable of the labeling the Agreement requires.

Proprietary Information turns on Information "which a Party desires to protect", a subjective and unverifiable test, coupled to designation "in the maimer provided by this Agreement". A court could be asked whether unmarked material the discloser subjectively wished to protect qualifies at all.

The lead-in sentence has no operative verb ("All Information which is disclosed ... and which is to be protected hereunder as Proprietary Information of the disclosing Party."), so it is grammatically incomplete and does not say what follows from the labeling and thirty-business-day write-up steps. Whether (a) and (b) are conditions precedent to protection or merely administrative is the whole question of the marking regime.

The care standard here is the receiving Party's own care for its own Proprietary Information "of like character", which cannot be squared with the separate warranty in the reasonable-safeguards provision that the Party "applies reasonable safeguards". A court would have to decide which of the two standards governs a claimed lapse in protection.

This warranty of "reasonable safeguards" sits against the treatment-and-safeguarding provision's own-degree-of-care standard for Proprietary Information, and the two measures of the receiving Party's duty are not reconciled. Which controls determines whether internal practice or an objective benchmark defines breach.

The permitted use is limited "solely for the purpose of evaluating the mutual interests of the Parties in the Project", but "Project" is defined nowhere in the operative terms — only in the WHEREAS recital about stents. The scope of the only operative use restriction therefore depends on whether and how the recital's definition controls.

The four exceptions are introduced by "unless and until such time as" appended to the non-disclosure clause (ii) alone, leaving it unclear whether they also release the use restriction in clause (i) and the safeguarding duty. The class of permitted recipients — "employees and consultants" engaged in consideration or evaluation of the Project — is also left without any flow-down obligation to define its limits.

The sentence is missing its subject and predicate object ("Except as expressly provided herein, ___ is granted by either Party ... under any patent, patent application, trademark, copyright") and breaks off mid-list, so it does not state that no license is granted. A court could be asked both what the omitted words were and whether trade secrets, absent from the truncated enumeration, are outside the disclaimer.

Declaring that all Information "shall remain the property of the disclosing Party" cannot easily be squared with the exceptions in the non-disclosure provision, which free independently developed, publicly available and third-party-sourced Information from restriction. A court would have to decide whether ownership persists in material the exceptions have released.

Return is triggered "Upon any termination of this Agreement", but the Agreement contains no term or termination provision at all — only the five-year safeguarding period in the treatment provision. What event triggers return, and whether obligations end with that five-year period, can only be resolved by reading the instrument as a whole.

The merger language reaches only "all prior discussions", saying nothing about prior written agreements or side letters, which invites an expressio unius argument that written prior understandings survive. It also leaves open whether the WHEREAS recitals form part of the integrated "entire agreement".
